{
  "schemaVersion": "PLATFORM_K3S_RUNTIME_CONTRACT_V1",
  "artifactKind": "platform-k3s-runtime-contract",
  "issueRef": {
    "repository": "AquilaXk/easysubway-platform",
    "issueNumber": 111,
    "parentIssueNumbers": [17, 77],
    "risk": "A_R3"
  },
  "distribution": {
    "name": "K3S",
    "version": "v1.36.3+k3s1",
    "architecture": "arm64",
    "binaryUrl": "https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/releases/download/v1.36.3%2Bk3s1/k3s-arm64",
    "binarySha256": "c9a209103f480f163b7c6a56f00862b4481927b284dc29a3716bb70d886691a8"
  },
  "host": {
    "provider": "OCI",
    "shape": "VM.Standard.A1.Flex",
    "nodeCount": 1,
    "ocpu": 4,
    "memoryGiB": 24,
    "edgeOwner": "HOST_NGINX",
    "publicHttpPort": 80,
    "publicHttpsPort": 443
  },
  "packagedComponents": {
    "disabled": [
      "traefik",
      "servicelb",
      "metrics-server",
      "local-storage"
    ],
    "helmChartCount": 0,
    "customOperatorCount": 0,
    "serviceMeshCount": 0
  },
  "networking": {
    "edgeOwner": "HOST_NGINX",
    "kubeProxyMode": "iptables",
    "nodePortAddresses": [
      "127.0.0.0/8"
    ],
    "activeServiceNodePort": 32080,
    "publicNodePortCount": 0,
    "ingressControllerCount": 0
  },
  "capacity": {
    "nodeCount": 1,
    "failureDomainCount": 1,
    "activeReplicaCount": 1,
    "maximumTransientCandidateReplicas": 1,
    "horizontalPodAutoscalerCount": 0,
    "podDisruptionBudgetCount": 0,
    "topologySpreadConstraintCount": 0,
    "multiHostHighAvailabilityClaim": false
  },
  "state": {
    "postgres": {
      "mode": "SAME_HOST_EXTERNAL_COMPOSE_SERVICE",
      "serviceName": "journey-postgres",
      "servicePort": 5432,
      "defaultPublishedHostPort": 15432
    },
    "objectStorage": {
      "mode": "SAME_HOST_EXTERNAL_COMPOSE_SERVICE",
      "serviceName": "journey-object-storage",
      "servicePort": 9000,
      "defaultPublishedHostPort": 9000
    },
    "endpointBinding": "SELECTORLESS_SERVICE_AND_ENDPOINT_SLICE_TO_NODE_INTERNAL_IP",
    "hostPathCount": 0,
    "persistentVolumeClaimCount": 0,
    "podLocalDatabaseCount": 0,
    "podLocalObjectStorageCount": 0
  },
  "identity": {
    "sourceFree": true,
    "releaseTupleSchemaVersion": "JOURNEY_RELEASE_TUPLE_V1",
    "canonicalAnnotationFields": [
      "tupleSha256",
      "backendImageDigest",
      "backendConfigDigest",
      "journeyContractDigest",
      "serverRouteBundleDigest",
      "deploymentRevision",
      "environmentIdentity",
      "candidateGeneration",
      "trafficGeneration"
    ],
    "configMapNameSource": "BACKEND_CONFIG_DIGEST",
    "secretNameSource": "SECRET_CONTENT_IDENTITY",
    "configAndSecretImmutable": true,
    "secretValueSerializedCount": 0
  },
  "workload": {
    "namespace": "easysubway-journey",
    "workloadServiceAccount": "journey-backend",
    "serviceAccountTokenAutomount": false,
    "runAsNonRoot": true,
    "runAsUser": 10001,
    "runAsGroup": 10001,
    "readOnlyRootFilesystem": true,
    "allowPrivilegeEscalation": false,
    "seccompProfile": "RuntimeDefault",
    "droppedCapabilities": [
      "ALL"
    ],
    "terminationGracePeriodSeconds": 30,
    "requiredProbes": [
      "startup",
      "readiness",
      "liveness"
    ],
    "resourceRequestsAndLimitsRequired": true,
    "boundedEmptyDirRequired": true
  },
  "deployer": {
    "namespace": "easysubway-journey",
    "serviceAccount": "journey-deployer",
    "clusterWideRoleCount": 0,
    "secretReadVerbCount": 0,
    "allowedResourceGroups": [
      "apps/deployments",
      "core/services",
      "core/configmaps",
      "core/secrets",
      "core/serviceaccounts",
      "core/pods",
      "core/pods/log",
      "core/pods/portforward",
      "discovery.k8s.io/endpointslices",
      "networking.k8s.io/networkpolicies"
    ]
  },
  "activationBoundary": {
    "candidateServiceType": "ClusterIP",
    "candidateProductionTrafficCount": 0,
    "candidateProbeBoundary": "TASK_OWNED_LOOPBACK_KUBECTL_PORT_FORWARD",
    "activeServiceType": "NodePort",
    "activeServiceSelectorCommit": "RESOURCE_VERSION_CAS",
    "applyActiveServiceDuringCandidatePreparation": false,
    "automaticRollbackCount": 0,
    "alternateOrchestratorSelectionCount": 0
  },
  "failure": {
    "result": "TYPED_NONZERO_OUTPUT_ZERO",
    "forbiddenSuccessSources": [
      "COMPOSE_FALLBACK",
      "LEGACY_ROUTE_V2",
      "PREVIOUS_OR_STALE_RELEASE",
      "LOCAL_SOURCE_CHECKOUT",
      "ALTERNATE_PROVIDER",
      "PLACEHOLDER_DATA"
    ]
  }
}
